title: Mandatory NBA Approval for Application of Intellectual Property Rights
content:
Section 6(1) states: 'No person shall apply for any intellectual property right, by whatever name called, in or outside India for any invention based on any research or information on a biological resource obtained from India without obtaining the previous approval of the National Biodiversity Authority before grant of such IPR.'

Procedural Compliance:
1. Timing of Approval: Under Section 6(1) as amended in 2023, approval of the NBA must be obtained BEFORE the grant of the patent / IPR (in India or abroad) and before commercial utilization.
2. Foreign Patent Filings: NBA approval is required before the grant of the patent abroad if the invention is based on an Indian biological resource. Applying to the NBA prior to or concurrently with foreign filing is standard practice to ensure timely grant. Procedural permission to file abroad for Indian residents is separately governed by Section 39 of the Patents Act, 1970 (Foreign Filing License - FFL).
3. Form: Filed via NBA Form II / Form III (Application for IPR on research results based on biological resources).
4. Statutory Exemptions: Section 6 does not apply to biological resources notified as 'Normally Traded as Commodities' (NTAC) under Section 40, nor does it restrict local traditional healers (vaidyas) exempt under Section 7.
